A cross-section of a standard earthen fish pond. Showing a gently sloping bottom. On the left, a water inlet pipe. On the right, a concrete structure called a 'monk' with wooden boards (spillway) controlling the water level, and a drainage pipe at the very bottom leading out through an earthen wall (dyke). A few fish are swimming in the water.

An illustration showing three different fish harvesting tools. Left: A fisherman on the bank throwing a circular Cast Net over the water. Middle: Two fishermen wading in shallow water, pulling a long Drag Net (Seine Net) between them, showing floats on top and weights on the bottom. Right: A woven basket-like fish trap with a funnel entrance lying underwater.
